system.description: When a permitted-Species creature you can see falls to 0 HP, spend a quarter of your max HP: the GM reveals its abilities and you install one as an implant. Up to (SL) implants, at most three internal; your prosthetic implants deal (SL × 2) extra damage, capped at 6.
